family.title: A family shop
family.p1: Cvećara Trofej is not a chain. Behind the counter is a family that has worked with flowers for years — the same people choose the flowers in the morning, tie the bouquet in the afternoon and answer the phone when you call.
family.p2: That is why every bouquet looks like it was made for one particular person, not off a template. When you tell us the occasion, we actually listen: whether it is an apology, a new baby, or someone who only likes white blooms.
family.p3: We work in our own neighbourhood, with people who have been coming back for years. That is the only reason we care about every bouquet that leaves the shop.

about.title: A small florist with a high standard
about.lead: Cvećara Trofej has been at {street} for years. We don't make bouquets in advance — each one is made once we know who it is for and why.
about.pillar1Body: We choose the flowers every morning. Whatever doesn't sell the same day never goes into tomorrow's bouquet.
about.pillar2Body: Tell us the occasion and the budget — we'll compose an arrangement that suits that particular person.
about.pillar3Body: Orders received by 2 pm are delivered the same day across Belgrade.
about.heroLead: Tell us the occasion and the budget — the rest is up to us.
about.contactLead: We take orders by phone and in the shop. We are open {weekdays} {weekdayHours}, Saturdays {saturdayHours}. Closed on Sundays.
